Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the clear remittance string. A couple quick asks so we can finish payment onboarding on our side: 

1) Can you confirm whether you prefer ACH for routine vendor payments or wire for initial setup? We typically process via ACH unless we see a bank letter requesting wire only.
2) Please provide a signed bank letter or a scanned voided check for account verification (our payments team requires one of these).
3) Confirm the EIN exactly as it appears on the W9 (we'll match against vendor records).

I’ve looped in Priyom (procurement) and Rishi (finance) to validate the docs and schedule micro-deposits as required. Once we have the bank-letter/voided-check and EIN, procurement will kick off the micro-deposit verification and then I’ll confirm the remittance string in our invoice ingestion pipeline.

Thanks — aiming to have this live before your first PO ships.

— Vanessa Ortiz
